# eerrgin / Greyfield FM

Name: Ergin Kaplan (eerrgin)
Site: https://eerrgin.github.io/
Location: Istanbul, Türkiye
Status motif: 0xB16B00B5_ACTIVE
Axiom: "kod yarına kalır, yanına kalmaz."

## What this site is
A personal workshop for small software experiments, local-first ideas, retro interfaces, independently generated browser audio, and short notes.

## Main projects
- VeilCheck: local heuristic scanner for suspicious secret-like patterns in files.
- GreySignal: read-only HTTP security-header inspection.
- ReconX: authorized reconnaissance utilities.
- local-sqli-lab: offline SQLite learning lab.

## Data and privacy
- No analytics, ad pixels, or tracking scripts are intentionally installed.
- Live weather, Hacker News, Wikipedia, and public GitHub repository information are fetched from their respective providers; each can fail independently.
- Greyfield FM generates sound in the browser with Web Audio API and does not stream or bundle third-party songs.
- Local media is not uploaded by the page. Selecting a file in the optional tape player uses a browser object URL for the current session.

Security tooling is intended for systems the user owns or has explicit permission to assess. Missing headers or heuristic matches are not proof of compromise.
